% ---- knap
\cssec{Knapsack}
\begin{itemize}
  \item $\max p^{\top}x$, $w^{\top}x\le W$, $x\in\{0,1\}^n$; relaxation $0\le x\le1$.
  \item Relaxation: sort by $p_i/w_i$, whole items, one fraction; value $U$.
  \item Integer profits: $\text{opt}\le\lfloor U\rfloor$. Rounding down is only a heuristic.
\end{itemize}

% ---- bnb
\cssec{Branch and bound}
\begin{itemize}
  \item Node $N$: fixed variables; $U(N)$ = fixed profit + relaxation of the rest.
  \item Close if infeasible, if $U(N)\le z_{\text{inc}}$, or if integral (update $z_{\text{inc}}$).
  \item Branch on the fractional variable: $x_j=1$, $x_j=0$.
  \item Depth first: memory, early incumbent. Best bound: fewer nodes.
  \item Any time: $z_{\text{inc}}\le\text{opt}\le\max\bigl(z_{\text{inc}},\max_{\text{open}}U(N)\bigr)$.
\end{itemize}

% ---- cut
\cssec{Gomory cut}
\begin{itemize}
  \item Row $x_k+\sum_N\bar a_jx_j=\bar b$, $\bar b\notin\mathbb Z$: $\sum_N\{\bar a_j\}x_j\ge\{\bar b\}$.
  \item Valid for integer points, violated by the LP optimum; substitute slacks to get it in $x$.
\end{itemize}

% ---- dp
\cssec{The DP table}
\begin{itemize}
  \item $D(i,c)=\max\{D(i-1,c),\,p_i+D(i-1,c-w_i)\}$, $D(0,c)=0$, answer $D(n,W)$.
  \item Back: $D(i,c)=D(i-1,c)\Rightarrow$ out; else in, $c\mathrel{-}=w_i$.
  \item One row: $0$–$1$ scan $c$ down; unlimited copies scan up.
  \item $O(nW)$ is pseudo-polynomial; subset sum is the case $p=w$.
\end{itemize}

% ---- model
\cssec{Binaries}
\begin{itemize}
  \item $A\Rightarrow B$: $y_A\le y_B$; at most $k$: $\sum y\le k$.
  \item Fixed charge: $x\le u\,y$, $-f\,y$; smallest valid $u$.
  \item $z=x_ix_j$: $z\le x_i$, $z\le x_j$, $z\ge x_i+x_j-1$.
  \item $z=y\,x$, $0\le x\le u$: $z\le uy$, $z\le x$, $z\ge x-u(1-y)$.
\end{itemize}

% ---- forms
\cssec{Formulations}
\begin{itemize}
  \item $P_1\subseteq P_2$: $P_1$ stronger, better bound, smaller tree.
  \item Disaggregate: $x_{ij}\le y_j$ beats $\sum_ix_{ij}\le m\,y_j$; cliques beat pairs.
\end{itemize}

\end{multicols}
